A lock orphaned by a dead worker ages out after RECLAIM_LOCK_SECONDS and is stolen, following the same rule as the lease, and the re-read still guards the write. The lock file does not match the *.json glob so nothing reads it as a claim. Five tests including the threaded two-worker race; three fail against the unfixed file on every run.
